name: Lin Wenqi
intro: Exploring how motion, materials and code shape real-time visual response.
about: I’m a Computer Science undergraduate developing a practice in Technical Art, with a focus on shaders, VFX and the systems that connect them. My projects explore the relationship between technical decisions and readable visual feedback.

projects.name: Project Kinetica
projects.summary: A focused Technical Art study connecting weapon motion, impact evaluation, vertex deformation and material-specific particles.
